scenario.name: Default Demonstration Scenario (Synthetic)
scenario.description: Synthetic dataset representing a central distribution hub in the Nashik region dispatching perishable produce to 6 major Indian markets. All data is synthetic and generated with seed=42 for reproducibility. This does not represent actual market prices, demand, or transport conditions.

explanation.why_this_batch: Batch BATCH-TOM-01 contains 613 kg of Tomatoes with 28.0h remaining shelf life. Allocated 613 kg (100% of batch).
explanation.why_this_destination: Mumbai — Vashi APMC Market has 4269 kg remaining demand for Tomatoes at ₹45.36/kg (priority 1). This destination offers the highest net contribution among feasible options.
explanation.why_this_route: Transport via TR-MUMBAI-05 (Central Hub — Nashik Region → Mumbai — Vashi APMC Market): travel 16.3h + handling 3.0h = 19.3h total transit. Cost: ₹3.38/kg. Capacity: 10000 kg.
explanation.why_this_quantity: Quantity 613 kg is the minimum of: batch remaining (613 kg), destination demand (4269 kg), transport capacity (10000 kg).
explanation.dispatch_priority: Priority rank #1. High urgency due to short shelf life. Net contribution: ₹24814.24 (₹40.48/kg).
explanation.shelf_life_analysis: Shelf life at delivery: 8.7h (original 28.0h - transit 19.3h). Tight margin — monitor closely.
explanation.what_makes_infeasible: This allocation would become infeasible if: travel time exceeds 25.0h, or transport cost rises above ₹45.36/kg (breakeven), or remaining demand drops below 613 kg.
